name: Starcaller (Moon Guard) threat-related abilities generate the threat their tooltips promise
contract: Chosen of the Moon 680755/680756 (Moon Guard talent): 'Become the chosen of the moon, reducing all Physical damage taken by -60% and taunting all enemies within 8 yds for 10 seconds.' DBC: 680755 Effect[1] is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL -> 680756, which applies SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT (effect0) in an 8 yd radius around the caster (TARGET_SRC_CASTER/TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, SpellRadius 14). The AoE taunt mechanism matches the tooltip. Like every other pure-MOD_TAUNT ability in this batch (Blood Howl 800782, Absolution 800424), ThreatManager::TauntUpdate (src/server/game/Combat/ThreatManager.cpp) only reorders taunt priority among ThreatReferences already on the target's threat list ('Only the last taunt effect applied by something still on our threat list is considered'); it cannot switch a victim the caster never had any threat against, so this scenario (whose caster never damaged moon_target before taunting) only asserts that the taunt aura lands, not a victim switch.
Command 804386 (ClassSpells level 12): 'Taunt an enemy to attack you for $d.' DBC Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_ATTACK_ME targeting the enemy; no threat-amount claim beyond the taunt itself.
